meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 它会为 NanoClaw 安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 监控面板和一个 pusher：pusher 每 60 秒推送一次 JSON 快照、每 2 秒推送日志，并把启动逻辑接入 src/index.ts，面板默认跑在 localhost:3100/dashboard。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控面板时使用，比如执行 /add-dashboard。面板展示 agent 组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量与实时日志。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 装上监控面板
say.note: 会安装面板与 pusher 并接入代码

say.text: 把 dashboard 的端口改成 3200
say.note: 改 .env 里的 DASHBOARD_PORT 后重启

say.text: 把 NanoClaw 的 dashboard 卸掉
say.note: 按移除步骤删文件、依赖和配置

howto.what_en: It installs the @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard package plus a pusher into NanoClaw: the pusher posts JSON snapshots every 60s and logs every 2s, and startup is wired into src/index.ts, serving the UI at localhost:3100/dashboard.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw, e.g. by running /add-dashboard. It shows agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, and live logs.

say_en.text: Add the monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
